canada.title: Provinces waiting to see if Trump follows through on data centre tax threat
canada.summary: The U.S. president threatened to impose "a tremendous tax" on American firms that build their data centres abroad, saying the U.S. could fall behind China in the artificial intelligence race as growing political backlash threatens to put the brakes on American data centre development.

canada.title: No change to property tax increase after 1st day of budget talks at Saskatoon's city hall
canada.summary: Saskatoon city council made no progress on either raising or lowering next year's property tax increase during the first day of budget talks Tuesday. The property tax hike is set at 5.45 per cent.

canada.title: Bedbugs will keep Fort Simpson, N.W.T., school closed until at least Nov. 30, officials say
canada.summary: The school building in Fort Simpson, N.W.T. has been closed since Monday, after an infestation of bedbugs prompted many families to keep their kids at home.

canada.title: Alberta government plans Sovereignty Act pushback against federal hate speech law
canada.summary: Alberta’s government is planning to introduce a motion under the province’s Sovereignty Act targeting the federal government’s recent anti-hate legislation.

canada.summary: The president and CEO of Santé Québec, the Crown corporation overseeing health care in the province, will leave her post on May 5, 2027.

canada.title: Peel police officer who shot Jamal Francique says he acted out of ‘fight-or-flight’ instinct
canada.summary: A police officer who shot a Black man in the head during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago told a coroner’s inquest Tuesday that he did not make a conscious decision to open fire but instead acted out of a ‘fight-or-flight’ instinct.

canada.title: Sask. shifting to immediate penalties instead of criminal charges for some impaired driving
canada.summary: New legislation introduced by the Saskatchewan government would implement immediate administrative penalties, instead of criminal charges, for some impaired driving cases in a bid to free up police and court resources.

canada.title: Labrador businesses preparing 'on all fronts' as National Defence spends big money

canada.title: Man who died in police custody had 'exceedingly high' blood-alcohol content
canada.summary: A coroner's inquest heard that David Virgil Dykeman's 2023 death in Saint John police custody resulted from extreme alcohol and diazepam toxicity, and a police watchdog agency found no police criminality.

canada.title: Manitoba urged to continue work on wildfire response after devastating 2025 season
canada.summary: A new report examined how Manitoba can improve its wildfire response, after millions of hectares burned in the summer of 2025.

canada.title: Alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator asks court to revoke detention order
canada.summary: According to court filings, Melody Bryant was not the only one who initially failed to recognize killer Jesse Van Rootselaar was "genuinely dangerous." The motion says records show the shooter shared her plans widely and had even "received encouragement from other online contacts."

canada.title: Top civil servant in N.L. fisheries department also travelled on aquaculture company’s dime
canada.summary: The Legislative Standards Commissioner, Ann Chafe, is doubling down on her approval of a study trip to Scotland for Fisheries Minister Loyola O'Driscoll and his department's top civil servant Keith Sullivan. The travel was educational and "deemed to be in the best interest of the public," says a statement from Chafe's department on Tuesday.
